Copywriter (Loyalty)

Revolut

Países permitidosMéxico
Modalidad100% Remote (Home Office)
Idioma requeridoInglés fluido
Experiencia1–3 years of copywriting experience
SalarioTo be discussed during interview
HorarioFull-time
Tipo de contrataciónFull-time
Fecha de publicación2026-11-28 (Límite: 2026-12-28)

Descripción del puesto

Join Revolut's Loyalty team behind RevPoints to craft in-app partner ads, marketing communications, and copy guidelines in a fast-moving remote fintech environment.

Funciones principales

  • Write copy for partner and promotional ads in-app.
  • Review copy across lifecycle marketing comms, GTMs, and ad-hoc tasks.
  • Own and maintain copy processes and guidelines to improve quality and turnaround speed.
  • Partner with Loyalty, Travel, and PMM teams on upcoming product rollouts.

Requisitos

  • Excellent grasp of written and spoken English.
  • 1–3 years of copywriting experience in a similar role.
  • Strong organisational skills, proactivity, and stakeholder communication.
  • Nice to have: fintech or loyalty programme experience and understanding of performance metrics.

Beneficios

  • Remote position with high autonomy and direct impact on millions of users.
  • Strong career growth opportunities in a global fintech leader.
